children: European stock indexes are mixed to kick off a crucial week for markets that features Nvidia earnings and Anthropic's public listing. Tech and banking stocks weaken as investors shift out of cyclical sectors, with healthcare stocks rallying. The Stoxx 600 inches up 0.1%. London's FTSE 100 gains 0.2%, driven by consumer staple stocks even as mining stocks weaken. The German DAX is 0.1% lower, with chip maker Infineon falling 2.2%. Industrials giant Siemens is 1.7% lower. Healthcare stocks lead the CAC 40 up 0.3% in Paris. Italy's FTSE MIB falls 0.4% while the Spanish IBEX 35 inches up 0.1%. The Dutch AEX adds 0.1%, though ASML drops over 1%. (josephmichael.stonor@wsj.com)
